reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 34. Nay or No: 6. Not Voting: 0. Of 40 Yea or Nay votes where the Republican majority could be computed, 39 (98%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 210 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

stands_for.caption: Grouped by Congress.gov's official policy area. Shows how they voted, not why. Final-passage, amendment, and procedural votes can mean different things; read the note for each.

stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

This weekend, I joined @BillSpadea on @NEWSMAX to discuss the Take Care of America's Veterans Act and my work to honor Vietnam Veterans in the National Veterans Parade.

See my interview below. https://t.co/mA5KuFrMWI

This week, I had the honor of recognizing Rhonda Beck of Hendricks County.

Rhonda has been a dedicated leader with the Daughters of the American Revolution and the Indiana POW/MIA Council. Through her work, she has helped honor veterans and their families throughout Indiana.

Thank you, Rhonda, for your commitment to honoring our veterans and keeping faith with their families.

This week, I honored Roger Coffin, a veteran and respected leader in Morgan County and across Indiana.

Roger lived an extraordinary life of service and will be dearly missed by all who knew him. https://t.co/PbfimRI2Oh

Today, I met with a number of ambassadors from Africa. 
These members of the Diplomatic Corps joined me to talk about strengthening U.S. ties with the African continent.  

With so many natural resources and a young population ready to harness it, African countries are primed for https://t.co/Xog0yRaA9A

I cannot think of a better way to celebrate Veteran’s Day, than by passing the Take Care of America's Veterans Act.

This tremendous package which I cosponsored, will give veterans better access to healthcare, strengthen benefits, and reform outdated and bureaucratic processes at the VA that cause delays.

This package also contains the Major Richard Star Act, a priority for numerous Hoosiers and veterans in our district. I am especially glad to support this provision as a part of a comprehensive package to provide veterans overarching support. 

Now it’s time for the Senate to pass this bill and deliver for our veterans.
*Video by Beth Garrigal

Happy Veterans Day! 🇺🇸

Watch the video below to see a recap of Brutus' ride in the National Veterans Parade last Sunday! 

To every veteran who has served our country and defended our freedom, thank you. https://t.co/9JHaQRIERS

Happy Birthday to the @USMC! https://t.co/JIArOoOOha

Today, I spoke on the House Floor about riding aboard the replica Vietnam-era gun truck “Brutus” in yesterday’s National Veterans Parade.

I also reflected on my time in Vietnam and the many heroes I served alongside. Our veterans deserve our sincere gratitude for their service and sacrifice.

I hope bringing Brutus to Washington, D.C., offered a small but meaningful tribute to all our veterans. 

They truly deserve it.
National Veterans Parade 🇺🇸 https://t.co/abyB8haFfS

Today is the National Veterans Parade. 

I’m beyond honored to be riding inside the Vietnam gun truck, Brutus, a replica of the gun trucks I fought in during the Vietnam War. 

Thank you to all the veterans who have served our country. https://t.co/FNqqQhwUHr

The Vietnam-era gun truck replica “Brutus” is coming to Washington, D.C., for the National Veterans Parade on November 8!

As a convoy commander in Vietnam, I saw the courage of gun truck crews firsthand. These men saved many American lives, including my own. Ahead of Veterans https://t.co/kqvwhtfCGK

Today is the last day to apply for a U.S. Service Academy nomination through my office. 

Young Hoosiers in Indiana’s Fourth District who are ready to serve our nation must submit their applications and all required materials by 5 p.m. ET today, November 6.
God Bless America 🇺🇸 https://t.co/iHekGeHz1A

This Military Family Appreciation Month, I want to thank military families across Indiana and our nation. 

As a combat veteran, I know how much it means to have the love and support of family back home. For every birthday apart, every move, every night spent worrying, and every https://t.co/RhA6CcNO4w

Behind the powerful supply chain helping feed America are hundreds of Hoosiers whose work helps keep food in grocery stores across the country.

Read my op-ed in the @JournalReview about my recent visit to Pace Dairy in Crawfordsville, IN.
https://t.co/Mr93ZE2XG5
Hope everyone has a fun time tonight. Stay safe! 🎃 👻 https://t.co/rS67B82Eu2

Glad to join @USTreasury at Saab in West Lafayette to see firsthand how Indiana workers are helping build the aircraft that support our military.

Proud to see the important work happening right in our district!
https://t.co/2uqxFGWQWm

It's a great honor of mine to nominate young Hoosiers to attend our U.S. Service Academies. 

If you are considering this path, submit your application and all required materials to my office by November 6 at 5 p.m. ET.

https://t.co/d0dAUzfZIh

Serving constituents is my highest priority. I was elected to Congress for this exact purpose: to help make the lives of Fourth District Hoosiers better. 

If you live in the Fourth District and need help navigating a federal agency, do not hesitate to call my office. 

We are https://t.co/MkPiEj5hrj
🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸 https://t.co/kGjT4G8r6r

It's been spectacular spending time with Hoosiers across the district! I love every minute of it.

Thanks to everyone who's met with me and shared how we can keep our communities safe and strong.

Proud to be your voice in Washington. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/kiNb9UX5rt

Families facing Alzheimer’s deserve answers and time to plan for what comes next.

I’m proud to have cosponsored the Alzheimer’s Screening and Prevention (ASAP) Act to help improve access to Alzheimer’s testing services.

Hearing from Hoosiers about how this legislation could

Agriculture is so impactful to Indiana. 

According to @ISDAgov,
- $35.1 billion in estimated contributions to Indiana’s economy from agriculture.
- Over 94,000 farmers in Indiana
- No. 1 in the nation for popcorn production.
- No. 2 in the nation for pumpkin production.
- 94% of https://t.co/gFzfq3dyGu

Hoosier farmers, an important update: 

USDA announced $8 billion in one-time relief to help offset diesel and other harvest season costs. 

Protecting farmers’ bottom lines and keeping their operations strong is vital to ensuring they can continue to feed and fuel America and support rural communities.

In Indiana, 94% of farms are family-owned or operated. 

I know the years of work that go into caring for the land and building something your children can carry on.

A huge reason I voted for the Working Families Tax Cuts was its expanded estate tax exemption, which helps more families keep their businesses going and pass their farms and traditions down to the next generation.

The Sudan IMPACT Act will help strengthen economic cooperation between the United States and Sudan by creating real economic partnerships, giving the Sudanese new opportunities for economic growth. 

By prioritizing civilian protection, we can help lay the groundwork for a more stable and prosperous Sudan.
https://t.co/YfMdWsyzOK

Sharing a few favorites from Indiana’s Fourth District!

From family farms to favorite weekend stops, there’s so much to love about our corner of the Hoosier State. 

It’s an honor to represent the people who make it special. https://t.co/6qK8vxybQA

Today I introduced the Sudan IMPACT Act, which will establish an agricultural and minerals partnership between the United States and Sudan.

Sudan’s mineral resources could help expand the supply of materials we use in technologies Americans rely on every day, like phones and cars. 

This legislation offers a path toward greater economic cooperation with the United States and Sudan, provided Sudan’s government shows real progress in protecting its people.
https://t.co/GZnAckiwL1

Forged by the sea for 251 years. 
Defending our freedoms and projecting American strength across the globe.

Happy birthday, @USNavy! 🇺🇸 https://t.co/XMTHiCNlG9
Happy Columbus Day! https://t.co/70asKt81Wn

This National 4-H Week, I'm proud to honor the program that has prepared generations of Hoosiers for future success. 

As a 10 year 4-H member, celebrating youth in agriculture is one of my greatest joys. This week, we recognize the tremendous impact that 4-H has had on making the best better in Indiana! 🍀🌾

Agricultural research helps our farmers feed and fuel the world. USDA’s $180 million Seed Sovereignty Initiative will help researchers develop stronger crop varieties that can respond to new pests and diseases, all while reducing our dependence on foreign competitors.

This is a fantastic initiative from the @USDA. Farm security is national security, and this investment will help strengthen both.
https://t.co/V2XJ33JMTm

This week is World Space Week! 🚀 🌕 🛰️

This week unites more than 100 countries to celebrate space exploration. Here in Indiana, Purdue continues that spirit of exploration through world-class aerospace research. Boilermakers are helping develop the technologies that will shape the future of flight and space exploration.

The next giant leap could start right here in Indiana.

12% of Indiana's energy generation comes from nuclear energy and 20% of America's portfolio.

With rising energy costs and growing demand, we need to expand safe, reliable sources that can provide power 24/7.  Investing in nuclear means investing in reliable American power for decades to come.

*Source @IndianaOED

Indiana is one of the nation’s leading pumpkin producers, with nearly 7,900 acres planted in 2025. 

Our farmers work hard to make our favorite fall traditions possible. This season, visit a Hoosier pumpkin patch or farm stand and support Indiana agriculture! https://t.co/AkFEDOJ38D

This August, historic flooding hit Indiana, costing Hoosier lives, and leaving widespread destruction in its wake. Our farmers are still assessing crop damages as they enter the harvest season. 

I’m proud to work with the American Flood Coalition as a Federal Champion on common-sense efforts that keep Hoosiers safe, boost rural economies, and protect our producers and farmlands.

Amelia Earhart taught at Purdue and her plane, Electra, was owned by the University. Let’s hope we can finally learn what happened to the famous aviatrix and return home with answers to one of the world’s greatest mysteries.
https://t.co/3yTyDWZigq

Did you know Neil Armstrong went to Purdue University?

Armstrong’s time at Purdue was interrupted when he served as a naval aviator during the Korean War, flying 78 combat missions. After returning to Purdue and graduating in 1955, he went on to command Gemini 8, which completed the first successful docking of two vehicles in space.

Of course, Armstrong is best known for becoming the first person to walk on the Moon during Apollo 11.

What started at Purdue took Armstrong to the Korean War, then to space, and ultimately to the Moon, leaving a legacy that continues to inspire Americans today.
🇺🇸🏎️🚀 https://t.co/GxA4NZYz9X
https://t.co/M8Bjk26LFi

As fall begins, we mark National Farm Safety and Health Week. This week recognizes the importance of safe agricultural practices as our farmers begin the harvest season across Indiana.

According to @BLS_gov, agriculture remains the most dangerous industry nationwide. By prioritizing farm safety, we can all do our part to ensure Indiana agriculture remains a beacon of  safe industry practice.
Happy First Day of Fall! Wishing everyone a season filled with bountiful harvests, quality time spent with loved ones, and enjoyment of Indiana’s stunning foliage. 🍂 🪾🍁 https://t.co/b4m4MYOS5P

Today is National POW/MIA Recognition Day. We honor those who endured captivity as prisoners of war and those who remain missing in action.

As a combat-injured veteran, I know the true cost of going into battle. America needs warriors willing to sacrifice everything in defense of our freedom and liberty. Today, we remember their courage and sacrifice, and the families who still carry the pain of their absence.

It was my immense honor to join everyone in Plainfield for the Vietnam Traveling Memorial Wall. As a Vietnam vet, I was profoundly moved to experience this with my fellow Hoosiers.

Too many Vietnam veterans returned home without the welcome they deserved. The names on this Wall remind us of those who never made it back and assure their families their courage won’t be forgotten.

Thank you to everyone who visited and paid tribute. We will always carry their memory with us.

On this day in 1787, our Founding Fathers signed the United States Constitution, formally establishing our republic. 

Today, we honor our nation’s founding document and the freedoms it enshrines for all Americans. We are the greatest country on earth, governed of the people, by the people, for the people. 🇺🇸🗽

Indiana is an agricultural powerhouse! From corn and soybeans to mint, gourds, and so much more, Hoosier farmers produce an incredible variety of agricultural products.

Source: @ISDAgov and @IN_Corn https://t.co/MPzQ889XpF

Today, I had the privilege of honoring local Indiana student-athlete, Jhett Stillwell from the Town of Colfax, Indiana. Stillwell was named a Reserve Champion Student-Athlete of the Year at the National High School Rodeo Finals. This recognition highlights student-athletes who excel both in the rodeo and in their scholastic and personal achievements.

His reserve finish gives Indiana representation among the student-athletes recognized at the national level. Congratulations, Jhett, and thank you for all your hard work representing Indiana at such a competitive level.

AM radio remains one of the most effective methods of emergency broadcast transmission accessible to everyone. It’s a vital layer of America’s Emergency Alert System which provides public warnings about natural disasters, AMBER alerts, etc.

This is why I am proud to support the AM Radio for Every Vehicle Act, which ensures all newly manufactured vehicles must be equipped with AM radio at no additional cost to drivers. 

We must act now to protect public safety and secure emergency preparedness by passing this legislation.

Today, I had the privilege of honoring Pastor Timothy Hester of Grace Church in DeMotte, Indiana. Pastor Tim has been an exemplary leader at Grace for more than 34 years.

Through his ministry, Grace has grown into a thriving congregation and an active part of the DeMotte community. Thank you, Tim, for your dedication to Christ and all of God's children.
